Florida Department of State Election Results Data Extract fixture.

Source URL: https://results.elections.myflorida.com/ResultsExtract.Asp
POST data: ElectionDate=11/5/2024&OfficialResults=Y&PartyRaces=N&DataMode=
Fetch date: 2026-10-27

Trimmed to the first five counties (Alachua, Baker, Bay, Bradford, Brevard)
and six representative races (President, US Senate, US House 1, State Senate 1,
State House 1, Amendment 1). The extract is a tab-delimited file with one row
per candidate per county; statewide totals are obtained by aggregating across
counties.
